article.story: FORT WORTH, Texas -- — Clara Silva had 15 points and Lanie Grant scored 14 to lead 15th-ranked TCU to a lopsided 89-42 victory over Tarleton State on Sunday. Silva made 6 of 11 shots and 3 of 4 at the foul line for the Horned Frogs (3-0). Grant hit 5 of 7 shots with three 3-pointers and added four assists. Lara Somfai and Jadyn Wooten both scored 12 for TCU with Somfai adding nine rebounds. Jessie-May Hall pitched in with 11 points off the bench. Caroline Lyles had 10 points to lead the Texans (1-1). TCU missed all six of its 3-point shots in the first quarter but still managed to lead 15-11 after scoring the final four points. The Horned Frogs shot 10 for 18 (55.6%) in the second period with three 3-pointers and outscored Tarleton State 28-7 for a 25-point lead at the break. Wooten led TCU with 10 points at the half. TCU put together a 22-0 run at one point in the game and led by as many as 52 in the second half. The Horned Frogs made half of their 66 shots, including seven of their final 19 tries from 3-point range. TCU held the Texans to 33% shooting and turned 22 turnovers into 26 points. Up next Tarleton State: Hosts Sul Ross State on Wednesday.
